Introduction
This document outlines 
inspection check list I3, witch must by performed every six months as 
indicated by M6 in the title block .The technical specification of the battery group - 1020AH,8 HR - Rate, S.G = 1-170
The first draft is initiated and reviewed by 
eng. Nagy Bekheit Saleh,
accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.
This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes ..etc
Switch of the chargers, the isolating disconnecting switch
Tools and Equipment
Boots, goggles, plastic gloves, soda, clean water
Grease for interconnections of batteries
H2 S 04 electrolyte
Hydrometer
Work to be Carried Out
Connections should be tight and coated with an anti - 
 corrosive agent
Battery should by clean and free of corrosion
Record the readings of S.G and voltage
Adjust the batteries levels
Switch on one of the two chargers
Put the batteries on the equalizing state for 140 hours
